description: Component contracts. Each entry gives anatomy, chrome, states and the class shipped in dist/hardstock.css. Chrome is written as token references so the same spec ports to vanilla CSS, Tailwind or any component framework.

media.print: Anatomy and chrome carry over to print once measurements are re-derived from tokens.json print.derivation. Every `states` field is meaningless on paper: there is no hover, focus, active or disabled. For print composition use blocks.json printArchetypes and references/print.md rather than this file.

states.disabled: opacity .5, cursor not-allowed, shadow removed, border kept

states.hover: translate(-2px,-2px), shadow to md (only if the card is a link)

card.constraint: Never nest a card in a card. Split with a 2px rule instead.

states.invalid: border color semantic.danger, message below in mono 11px

input.label: mono 10px uppercase, above the field, never floating inside it

badge.anatomy: inline-flex, padding 4px 8px, mono 10px weight 700 uppercase, line-height 1
badge.constraint: Always carries a word. Fill alone is not a status.

avatar.anatomy: square, 32 to 40px, overflow hidden, one categorical fill, display font initial
avatar.constraint: Square. Not a circle, not a squircle.
avatar.decorative: rotate(-3deg to 12deg) and float animation, in feeds and hero collages only

toggle.anatomy: rectangular track 44x24, square knob 18px with shadow.xs

states.on: track fill semantic.success, knob at right

toggle.constraint: No pill track, no circular knob.

checkboxRadio.constraint: Radios are square too. Checked state fills with accent or cyan and draws an ink check or a solid square.

select.menu: 2px ink border block with shadow.sm, option hover surface.raised, selected accent

table.anatomy: 2px ink border around the whole table
table.header: surface.raised fill, mono uppercase, 2px ink bottom border
table.constraint: A hard-lined grid. No zebra stripes on rounded cards.

tabs.alternative: Underline form: a 3px ink bar under the active label

modal.panel: surface.plain or canvas, 2px ink border, shadow.lg, width min(640px, 90vw), max-height 80vh with internal scroll
modal.header: colored band (lavender by default) plus display title plus a close control top right
modal.required: Escape closes it, clicking the overlay closes it, focus is trapped inside

toast.anatomy: bottom-right block, semantic fill, 2px ink border, shadow.md
toast.motion: enters and leaves on translateX, never fade-and-scale
toast.required: Auto-dismiss plus a manual close control

tooltip.anatomy: ink fill with canvas text, mono 11px, shadow.xs, sharp, no arrow or a square-cut one

states.active: accent fill with 2px ink border and shadow.sm

navRow.constraint: Sidebar rows are not cards. Distinguish with fill, not with nesting.

skeleton.anatomy: surface.raised filled rectangle with 2px ink border
skeleton.motion: opacity pulse under 1s, disabled under reduced motion
skeleton.constraint: No spinner. A spinner is a circle.

emptyState.anatomy: centered monoline icon, one display sentence, optional mono hint, one primary button
emptyState.constraint: Never ship blank space. A blank region reads as broken.
